rules.source_quote: A landholder farmer’s family is defined as “a family comprising of husband, wife and minor children who owns cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State/UT”.
The benefit shall be paid to only those farmers’ families whose names are entered into the land records.
Benefit will be allowed in those cases where transfer of ownership of cultivable land takes place on account of succession due to death of the landowner.

In case of new beneficiaries being uploaded on the PM-KISAN Portal, all land holding farmers’ families who are Non-resident Indians (NRIs) in terms of the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961 shall be excluded from any benefit under the Scheme.
All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.
